name: codecKit
description: Serialise, compress and channel-encode Lua values into transport-safe strings behind a self-describing header, with decoding that never raises, for World of Warcraft addons.
summary: Serialise, compress and channel-encode values behind a self-describing header; decoding never raises.

Compression.description: Raw DEFLATE compression and inflation: Compress, Decompress, compress = "deflate" on the encoders and compressed frames on decode, natively through C_EncodingUtil.CompressString where the client has it.
